cases.name: bass-a
cases.caption: Instrumental bass music, 140 BPM, half-time drums, syncopated modulated bass phrases with rests, percussive vocal-like synth textures, call and response between bass and melodic lead. Sparse opening, a developing rhythmic motif, contrasting break, varied return and deliberate ending. No vocals.
